source.section: What I measured / Stage 1: Ollama, models that fit in VRAM

notes: Date is the date of the commit that first states the speed figure (d55bbb0; the VRAM figure first appears in 3765c6b), not of the measurement.
Number of runs, exact command, Ollama version and driver were not recorded.
The README says the number comes from Ollama's own timings; which Ollama command or field was read is not recorded.

Quantization Q4_K_M is the default tag that scripts/02-pull-models.ps1 says Ollama pulls, and docs/llama-cpp.md calls the stage 2 file the same model as Ollama; it was not read from the model at measurement time.
The VRAM figure is the approximate value stated next to the speed (about 6 GB).
